Duration constant

You have read this table more times than the people who wrote it.

When you roll on the Gun Failure Table, roll twice and use either result. You already roll a d6 rather than a d8; this makes the worst thing that can still happen to you something you had to agree to twice.

cinderfall.incomplete: same table-manipulation problem as above. This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to.
